speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with feeding intolerance and bilious vomiting; to help me understand your condition, can you tell me exactly how many hours after birth these symptoms started?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, 3050-g (6-lb 12-oz) male, six hours post delivery. The newborn has had several episodes of bilious vomiting and is intolerant to feeding since birth. Was born at term following an uncomplicated pregnancy, though the mother missed several prenatal checkups. The patient's older brother underwent surgery for pyloric stenosis as an infant.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given your brother's history with pyloric stenosis, does your vomiting appear to be forceful or projectile? Also, have you noticed any greenish bile in the stool, or has he passed meconium yet?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Bilious vomiting. I also have Feeding intolerance, No fever, Vomiting started within first day after birth.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Malrotation with Midgut Volvulus. The presence of bilious vomiting in a newborn starting within the first day of life is a surgical emergency until proven otherwise. Immediate surgical consultation is required for an urgent upper GI series.
